401866465.summary: Every preview picks Western Michigan (7-3, 5-1 MAC) at home, citing Jalen Buckley's run game (832 yards, 10 TD) and a defense allowing 18.7 points a game. Eastern Michigan has scored 13.7 a game in a three-game skid and may again be without starting QB Noah Kim. Two of the three take WMU to cover; the third picks only the moneyline.
401866465.pick: Western Michigan to win (all three sources); WMU to cover per WagerTalk (-14.5) and Doc's Sports (-15); Bang the Book picks the moneyline only
401866465.injuries: EMU: QB Noah Kim (undisclosed) missed the last two games, status for this game unclear; coach Chris Creighton said Nov 11 he is 'still hopeful' (Mitten Football). Brogan McCaughey and Jace Stuckey are the options if he sits (Mitten Football, Nov 16). WagerTalk (Nov 16) also lists RB N. Jones-Davis and WR S. Fishwick as injury concerns, no status given. WMU: unnamed reserve players out (WagerTalk); no starters reported out.

notes: Tuesday run: one tracked college game today (EMU @ WMU, Watch list); Ball State @ Ohio is not tracked. No NFL games today. No CBS/ESPN/Action Network preview found for this game; Bleacher Nation and ats.io previews would not load and were not used. Moneyline WMU -675 / EMU +490 (Bang the Book, checked Nov 17). WagerTalk names EMU's backups 'Blake McCaughey and Jalen Stuckey'; Mitten Football's 'Brogan McCaughey and Jace Stuckey' is used instead. Today's MAC availability report was not found, so Noah Kim's status is unconfirmed; the Mitten Football articles are partly paywalled (only the open portion was used).
